name: arc-xray
description: Read-only, source-backed architecture audits with interactive maps, execution sketches, editable diagrams and evidence-based review.

interface.longDescription: Inspect a user-selected project without executing its code. Create a standalone index.html and explore the same source-backed graph in an MCP Apps client. Includes map/tree layouts, source evidence, qualified architecture risks, finding logs, draw.io and Mermaid. Local Python runtime required; web/mobile need a separately accessible runtime and source access.
defaultPrompt: Create a read-only architecture atlas for this project.
Review architectural risks and connect each observation to source evidence.
